candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. E get cough or e dey breathe hard. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear wahala. E no get fever. I count the number of breath for one full minute. Pikin no dey calm. The cough don dey three days. Dem no get pulse oximeter for here. I no hear recurrent wheeze. E dey breathe 35 times for one minute. I no see chest indrawing. I no hear stridor when pikin calm. I no hear wheezing. E no dey convulse now. E never get convulsion before. E no dey lethargic or unconscious. E dey fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything.
